diagnosis: Customer on premium support with a 4-hour first-response target; their ticket took 11 hours, which is a breach. Priority routing entitlement is present, so queueing should have applied. Advise specialist review of why priority routing did not result in timely response.
reply: Thank you for flagging this. With your premium support tier, tickets enter the priority queue with a four-hour first-response target during business hours in your account's region. An eleven-hour first response falls well outside that target, and we take that seriously. I have recommended this ticket for escalation to a specialist.
